integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action documentary realism with a sci-fi exotic-wonder core, rendered with the visual gravity of a near-classical oil painting — warm ochre-yellow and brown-gold tones, fine pictorial texture, and a subtle film grain across the frame. An eye-level extreme wide shot with deep depth of field and centered composition opens on a wide, oval, waterlogged excavation pit, its floor a churned expanse of murky yellow-brown mud and standing water under bright, soft, even afternoon light; sunlight from the rear-side angle draws bright rim highlights along the metal edges of an orange-yellow loader parked at the pit edge and along the wet, glistening back of a horrifyingly oversized loach-like creature (体型骇人的超大泥鳅状生物) — its body longer than the vehicle itself, skin thick and deeply textured, a ridged fin-like crest along its spine — as the loader strains to hoist it from the churning muddy water in its front bucket. The creature thrashes violently in the bucket, its dorsal fin rippling and undulating, hurling sheets of mud and water into the air. In one continuous, unbroken camera movement (不间断的镜头移动), the camera pans left at slow speed, gradually revealing twenty to thirty onlookers spaced along the pit rim at a safe distance, phones raised to record and photograph, faces caught between shock, curiosity, and excitement. A man in the crowd with a sharp, startled voice (S1) exclaims: <d>[Chinese] 天哪，那是什么东西？！</d> Beside him, a woman urging the others on (S2) shouts: <d>[Chinese] 快拍快拍，别停！</d> The pan completes as the frame settles into a static hold on the full tableau — crowd, machine, and the colossal thrashing creature held together in one wide, unsettling spectacle — and the camera eases to a stop for the final beat, all captured from a calm third-party observational perspective.

overall_soundscape: The loader's engine emits a deep, continuous rumbling vibration while thick mud and water slap and churn as the creature thrashes in the bucket. Waves of exclamations and murmured discussion ripple through the crowd, punctuated by scattered phone shutter beeps.
